dogecoin.text:
Ledger users can now spend token balances globally with their hardware wallets.

Big win for those whose travel plans revolve around crypto conferences and ramen budgets!

Next stop?

Paying for coffee with Dogecoin and having the barista say, "Sorry, transaction fees are extra.

I'm the kind of person who invests in "Dogecoin" just to realize I'm a part of an internet joke, while balancing it with enough self-awareness to laugh alongside everyone else.

Life tip: never check your crypto wallet before coffee.
